data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The sum of all possible values of n is 16592.","counterconditions":[{"case":"A prime p exists such that p^20 is in the range [2006, 12005)","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"Other prime pairs (p, q) for p^6 * q^2 were missed within the range","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Let m = n + 2005. For m to have exactly 21 factors, its prime factorization must be of the form p^20 or p^6 * q^2. Given 1 <= n < 10000, we have 2006 <= m < 12005. For p^20, 2^20 is far too large. For p^6 * q^2: if p=2, m=64q^2, then 31.34 <= q^2 < 187.57, so q in {7, 11, 13} giving m in {3136, 7744, 10816}. If p=3, m=729q^2, then 2.75 <= q^2 < 16.45, so q=2 giving m=2916. If p=5, m=15625q^2, which is too large. The possible values for m are {2916, 3136, 7744, 10816}, corresponding to n = {911, 1131, 5739, 8811}. The sum is 911 + 1131 + 5739 + 8811 = 16592.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
